slots.root: fixed inset-0 z-palette flex items-start justify-center pt-[12vh] bg-scrim backdrop-blur-scrim
slots.panel: w-140 max-w-[92vw] bg-surface-floating border-[length:var(--bw-surface)] border-edge-surface-floating rounded-surface shadow-surface-deep overflow-hidden
slots.search: flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3.5 border-b-[length:var(--bw-separator)] border-edge-field
slots.input: flex-1 bg-transparent border-none outline-none text-ink-body placeholder:text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted) font-body text-ctl
slots.esc: font-mono text-ctl-xs text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted) border-[length:var(--bw-marker)] border-edge-control-quiet rounded-marker px-1.5 py-0.5
slots.groupLabel: px-3 pt-3 pb-1.5 font-face-label text-label font-bold tracking-label-role case-label text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted)
slots.row: flex items-center gap-items w-full min-h-ctl-h text-left px-control-x py-2.5 rounded-control border-none cursor-pointer no-underline shadow-control-rest active:scale-[var(--press-scale)] motion-reduce:active:scale-100
